initialPrompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Produce ONE finished square full-scene Burbz manga RPG card. Image 1 is the recovered original BLUE TIT artwork to restore and restyle, not a cutout. Image 2 is the user's exact CURRENT TREECREEPER CARD style reference. Restyle the Blue Tit into the same authentic hand-inked manga rendering as Treecreeper: strong expressive dark contours, delicate controlled feather and branch hatching, dramatic but readable shadow masses and restrained illustrated natural colour. Preserve Image 1's blue-tit identity, slender bird pose perched on a flowering branch, distinctive blue cape and small sheathed blade; preserve its entire integrated woodland/garden scene rather than making a portrait cutout. Strengthen the Blue Tit's own design as a nimble spring orchard scout: lightweight azure shoulder cape follows natural folded feathered wings, narrow weathered leather harness, small subtle blossom-and-leaf clasp. Leave yellow breast, white face, dark blue eye-stripe and blue crown plainly recognizable; olive back, blue wings and tail, tiny pointed dark beak. Species is Eurasian Blue Tit (Cyanistes caeruleus), NOT Great Tit: no solid black cap and no broad black belly stripe. Precisely ordinary bird anatomy, two folded feathered wings and EXACTLY TWO slender scaly legs/feet gripping the branch. No human arms, no human hands, no fingers, no extra limbs, no human torso. Any blade stays in its sheath on the harness, never held. Clothing tailored to the bird, not generic bulky armour. Treecreeper-like integrated storytelling image: white spring blossoms, twisting branch, layered orchard/woodland depths and warm slanting daylight rendered with the same confident ink linework as the bird. Keep head, both feet and full blue tail inside square with small safe margins; bird fills about 70% of image. Opaque full background edge to edge, no framing border, no text, logos or watermark. Avoid photographic feathers, airbrushed/3D look, chibi, detached collage, pasted realistic cutout, extra birds. Do not modify the Treecreeper source card.
